p1b: got ready for school today, he went downstairs to have breakfast with his family. Before that, the human was kind enough to ask if
p1c: wanted anything brought up to him. His family, while good people (yet embarrassing to be around), may not take Sonic’s appearance as lightly as he did. Sonic did blurt out "no cat food!", which Issei assured him he wasn’t gonna give him anyway. He may be a pervert and not the brightest student in the classroom, but he wasn’t THAT stupid either. Still, it was a strange item Sonic had requested...
p2: A Chili Dog? In the morning?
p3: Whatever. The alien had his own diet apparently. While they didn’t have any franks to make them with, Issei promised Sonic there was a concession stand they could go to on the way to school, which sold Fried Noodle Hot Dogs. Not exactly what Sonic asked for, but the little Hedgehog was willing to try it. Speaking of which, there was no way Issei could go out into the world with an anthropomorphic animal next to him.
d1: Sonic: Heh, you were almost killed by Angels, yet afraid of walking around with me?
d1_note: Sonic joked when Issei brought the subject up.
d2: Issei: It’s not that, bro. I just don’t think people are gonna be as calm and collected as I am
d3: Sonic: Yeah... you were calm and collected alright
p4: The human had to admit, the Hedgehog had a decent sense of humor. Still though, Issei had to give him some sort of disguise. He ravaged through his closet until he found something that could help. It was a leather jacket Issei used to wear when he was younger, and it looked to be around Sonic’s size. He also gave Sonic a pair of red glasses to go with it.
d4: Issei: Try these on, I’ll be right up
d4_note: said Issei, heading back downstairs to eat with his family before they had to leave for work themselves.
p5: Seeing as he’ll have to wait (just what he loved to do), Sonic eyed the outfit Issei prepared for him. He was truly a nice kid, just had... issues. It didn’t take long for Sonic to dawn the gear Issei left him. He looked over himself once he put it on.
d6: Issei: Alright Sonic, ready to g...?
d6_note: Issei asked, but that’s when the leather jacket was thrown in his face as he entered to room after cleaning up his mess from breakfast downstairs.
d7: Sonic: Got anything else? I’m not wearing that
d8: Issei: Why not? It’s perfect. You’ll blend in while looking cool!
d8_note: Said Issei, taking the jacket off his face and holding it.
d9: Sonic: Uh, nooooo. COOL... would be a cowboy hat or SOAP shoes! Sonic is NOT waltzing around town like a generic alter-ego
p6: Issei has no idea what Sonic was going on about, but now saw another side of Sonic’s personality. He may be heroic, but also stubborn. Issei couldn’t lie, he too could be the same way. When he wanted a porno video from Motohama one time that also wasn’t legally available on the market yet, Issei had to get pictures of girls in their locker room as payment. The catch was, they had to be naked, or at least in their undergarments. It was a fair (and totally worth it) trade.
p7: He was caught in the act of course, and beat to the verge of death for it, but still...
d10: Issei: Sonic-Bro... it’s all I got. Can you please put it on?
d10_note: Said Issei, requesting Sonic to swallow his pride and wear the disguise.
d11: Sonic: I’d rather run around naked than wear that thing
d12: Issei: Can you just... wait a minute. You’re already naked!
d13: Sonic: No I’m not! I’m wearing gloves!
d13_note: Defended Sonic, pulling the glove back a bit and letting it snap against his skin as if to prove a point.
d14: Issei: Then can you add it to your ‘attire’ to at least LOOK human?
d15: Sonic: Or I could just drop you off at school and dash back here. No one’ll see me
p9: Issei has a bit of trouble believing that one. Sure Sonic moved quickly around his room, but that?
d16: Issei: Yeah. Like you go to Kinkaku-ji temple and take a piece of its roof in under...
p11: That is, until Sonic dashed out of his room... and came back in literally 3 seconds with a gold brick in his hand. Issei’s jaw hung for a second before he closed his mouth. Kinkaku-ji wasn’t too far from Kuoh anyway, taking a few hours by train, so it proved nothing... right?
d17: Issei: Ok. But it’s not like you can get to Egypt in...
d17_note: Issei said, but Sonic darted to Issei’s desk and swiped the human’s phone...
p13: It took a few seconds longer, but Sonic came back, and tossed Issei back his phone... showing the Hedgehog had taken a selfie of him and a pyramid. He was sticking his tongue out, and held up 2 fingers. When was the picture taken?... 5 seconds ago.
d18: Issei: ...ALRIGHT! But there is NO way you can go ALL the way to America and...
p15: Once again, a few extra seconds and Sonic had returned. This time; he was wearing a polka dot party hat with fuzz on the top, holding a party spinner in one hand (which he spun a few times), and a mini American flag in the other. He also had a blow tickler (AKA: a party horn) in his mouth, which he blew into, making a quick playful honk sound.
d19: Sonic: I can do this all day, bud
p16: said Sonic, with the party horn hanging out the side of his mouth so he could talk clearly. Issei just deadpanned, unamused.
d20: Issei: ... Just wear the damn thing
d20_note: he grumbled, not in the mood to argue anymore.
p17: Sonic thought about it for a moment. He spit the horn out of his mouth to the side of Issei’s room, tossed the party items in the same direction, and finally popped off the hat before repeating the same action.
d21_note: he said, then folded his arms and finished with:
d22: Sonic: But I’m not wearing pants!
p19: Here ya are. One Fried Noodle Hot Dog.
p20: said Issei, taking what he ordered from the concession stand clerk, as he promised Sonic earlier. After handing the treat to Sonic (now disguised), he paid the clerk and both boys walked down the street.
d24: Sonic: MMMMMM! Ohhh, yeah! That’s the stuff!
p21: Said Sonic after taking a bite out of the hot dog. It was still strange to Issei that Sonic had such an item this early in the morning.
d25: Issei: So, uh... where exactly did you come from? You mutate in the sewers with a rat and 4 turtles?
d25_note: Asked Issei, wanting to know more about his new friend.
p22: After taking another bite and swallowing, Sonic eyeballed him.
d26: Sonic: You watch WAY too many cartoons. I’m just your average, supersonic Hedgehog
d27: Issei: Yeah... you’re totally average. Seriously, where ya come from?
d28: Sonic: I’m from a place called Mobius, ever hear of it?
d28_note: Asked Sonic, to which Issei just stared at the Hedgehog like he was crazy.
d29: Sonic: Eh... so this IS another dimension
d29_note: Sonic said, taking a third bite of his breakfast.
d30: Issei: Another dimension?! How the hell’d you end up here?
d30_note: Asked Issei, but surprised and interested.
p23: And the way Sonic worded his answer, it sounded like he’s been through it before... many times. Normally, Issei would have thought this was something right out of a fantasy porn, and would’ve shrugged it off. But after last night and this morning, he was willing to listen.
d31: Sonic: In a nutshell, I was sent here by a freak accident. And the only way I can get home, is by leaving the same way I came... though I don’t know if the Emeralds are here or not
d31_note: Sonic said, finishing his snack with one last big bite.
d32: Issei: Emeralds?... That’s easy, there’s plenty of jewelry shops here in Kuoh
d33: Sonic: ... I know a bat that would LOVE to take you up on that offer, but what I’m looking for are more than mere gems you can buy for a few hundred bucks. They’re called Chaos Emeralds. Seven in total, unlimited power, and are sought after for that reason
d33_note: Sonic explained, wiping his face with the napkin that came with the Noodle Hot Dog.
p24: So you lost some Dragon Balls, and you think they transported here with you?
p25: Sonic eyed Issei again upon the ‘Dragon Ball’ comparison.
d34: Sonic: ... I honestly don’t know, it’s... really hard to explain. Those Emeralds are unpredictable. Even though I’ve used them so many times, I STILL don’t fully understand them
d35: Issei: Well, what DO you know about them?
d35_note: Questioned Issei, wanting to know more.
p26: He kinda didn’t believe it though, but also had no reason to think Sonic would lie about something like this... the blue Hedgehog didn’t seem like the type.
d36: Sonic: Well... the most common thing about them is that even just one can power an entire city. They even change your thoughts into power...
d37_note: Issei repeated, not fully understanding what Sonic said. It sounded like a riddle.
d38: Sonic: Ya know, whatever you’re thinking, the Emeralds can make it possible
p27: Issei repeated, then looked all around him. There were actually some students walking down this same road... all girls. And knowing Issei, he began to have lewd thoughts...
p29: Issei is holding a green Emerald of some kind in his right hand, raising up to the heavens.
d40: Issei: HAAAA! HAHAHAHAHA! Change my thoughts into power? Well, let’s change these boring uniforms... INTO SEE-THRU KIMONOS!
d40_note: Ordered Issei, the Emerald glowing with power.
p30: Suddenly, all the girls’ clothes changed into exactly what he wanted. All the girls’ bras and chests were on display for Issei to see, and he couldn’t be happier.
d41: Issei: THIS IS AWESOOOOOOOME! With this Emerald, nothing will stop me from becoming the Harem Ki- ARRRRRRRGH!
p33: Sonic had pulled Issei’s ear down, dragging his head down to his eye level and out of his daydream.
d42: Sonic: Cool your jets there, Romeo. These Emeralds aren’t toys
p34: the Hedgehog said in a serious tone, somehow predicting or reading Issei’s thoughts. He let Issei go after 2 seconds.
d43: Sonic: They’re powerful, sure... but can also be VERY dangerous if misused. Trust me... I know
p35: Sonic thought, having several flashbacks to various ‘incidents’ the Emeralds had caused from someone or something seeking their power:
villain_eggman_name: A mad scientist in a red lab coat
villain_lizard_name: A lizard with a colony up its butt
villain_blackdoom_tail: that a black Hedgehog had to face on his own.
villain_chaos_tail: that flooded an entire city in a matter of seconds.
p37: A five-headed dragon that wanted to destroy all non-plant life.
villain_wisp_tail: that was a mother figure to wisp-like beings (though this was technically the madman’s fault and not the Emeralds).
villain_mephiles_name: A hedgehog formed from pure Negative Chaos Energy
villain_ix_name: And the leader of a supposedly extinct race of Echidnas
d44: Sonic: If they ARE here, I HAVE to find them before they fall into the wrong hands... or people might get hurt
d44_note: said Sonic, keeping his serious tone of voice.
p38: Issei still had trouble believing this of course, but Sonic sounded too genuine for this to be a lie. The human didn’t know, all he DID know was Sonic and Yuuma’s presence confirmed there was more going on in the world than most humans realize. Nevertheless, both boys had finally gotten to Kuoh Academy.
d45: Issei: Thanks for walking with me, bro. I appreciate it. Where will you go now?
d46: Sonic: Oh, don’t worry about me, Issei... I’ll be around
p39: said Sonic, dashing off in a blue blur, leaving Issei to go to school. He was right... not a single person noticed him rush off.
p40: Issei smiled before heading onto the school grounds, Sonic seemed like he was gonna be here awhile... assuming his story was true. Issei wondered if he should tell Matsuda and Motohama, would they be willing to keep a secret about an alien Hedgehog that can run at incredible speeds? Probably, or they might just blackmail Issei into letting them ‘borrow’ Sonic, and then force the Hedgehog to do ‘favors’ for them. Imagine what they could get away with if they had Sonic take pictures for them, or dash into girls locker rooms for ‘goodies’?... Yeah, maybe not.
p41: What neither he or his new friend knew... was a certain redhead with her arms folded and leaning against the front doors of the academy, was watching them via some form of enhanced vision, with a smile of her own.
